title: Hula Girl Sport Fishing
specs: Target popular Big Island game fish including Blue Marlin, Striped Marlin, Mahi Mahi, Short-nose Spearfish, and Wahoo
Bring your food and beverages, sunblock, hats, sunglasses, and camera
Up to six passenger-anglers per charter
includes: Cooler with ice for food and drinks
blurb: Guests join fishing charters targeting popular Big Island game fish. Trips include tackle, cold bottled water, and a cooler with ice. Guests can keep their catch or tag and release.
extraNote: Hawaii taxes and fees are added to all charter fees · Require a credit card to hold and confirm the reservation · No fish is put to waste; catch can be filleted if guest has kitchen access, otherwise shared or sold locally · Honokohau Harbor & Marina
